spec.name: grain-8192-v3
spec.comment: ADR 0066 grain sweep at N = 8: filter rows per task 1 to 1024, local histogram KB per task 1 to 8192, powers of two, plus Rayon's adaptive split (no grain). passes = (8192 / 8192)^2 = 1 as in the cutoff campaign (ADR 0064). The atomic histogram, which takes a grain since measured/v3, is swept at the grains of the local one. Run again on measured/v3 (ADR 0084).
